statement_summary: Security and compliance coordinator and OT security decision owner designated in writing
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment and after major changes
Risk acceptance authority; public health risks never accepted above Low
Sanctions; good-faith reporting protected
Security terms before vendor OT access or holding company files
Independent assessment every 2 years; self-review in between
Security records kept at least 5 years
Policy review every August; available to staff
Written, risk-rated, time-limited exceptions
Security changes must keep the engineered safeguards and hand operation
Named accounts; shared HMI login replaced by 2026-12-31
HMI roles and least privilege with written approval
MFA on email, SaaS, remote desktop, remote monitoring, and all administrator logins
Remote HMI access only through the remote desktop tool with named accounts and MFA; no unattended access
Leaver checklist covering OT accounts, keys, and shared passwords changed the same day
Monthly business account reconciliation; quarterly OT user review
Integrator sessions approved and watched; named technicians; MSP technician list
Weekly remote access log review; monthly HMI change review
Default device passwords changed; credentials only in the password manager; guest Wi-Fi
PLC key switch in RUN; program mode only for approved work; PLC password
Company systems for company work; customer look-ups only as needed
No Restricted information in personal accounts or public AI tools
No personal devices or USB drives on the HMI computer or plant network
Awareness training yearly with phishing simulations; OT training for operators
Report suspected incidents at once
Signed policy acknowledgment
HMI compromise runbook kept as the emergency plan's cyber annex; printed copies
Report within 1 hour, including unexpected HMI behavior
Safe water first: hand operation, grab sample, cut remote access
Grab samples every 4 hours if the residual record fails; state notice if the minimum residual is not restored within 4 hours
Tier 1 notice and primacy agency consultation within 24 hours when required
48-hour violation report; 10-day public notice certification
Insurer hotline first; FBI and CISA within 24 hours of declaration
Customer data breach decision and notices; vendor 10-day breach notice in contracts
Ransom only with approvals and an OFAC check
Preserve evidence without delaying safe-water actions
Log every incident and the time the company learned of it
Annual tabletop with the integrator and MSP plus a hand-operation drill
Lessons learned within 30 days
Three classification levels with OT information as Restricted
Restricted information only in named locations; drawings and passwords out of the shared folder
Encrypt Restricted information at rest and in transit
OT inventory and SaaS and device list, reviewed quarterly
Offline encrypted PLC and HMI backups monthly and after changes; quarterly logic comparison
Nightly office backup with 90-day versions; quarterly restore test
Drinking water records kept for the 40 CFR 141.33 periods; monthly export of the residual record
New tools and AI features approved before use; anomaly detection advisory only
Plant binder locked, numbered, and refreshed monthly
Wipe or certified destruction; customer records made unreadable
